description: This file defines the RedshiftDataAPIServiceClient class in the Aws\RedshiftDataAPIService namespace, extending AwsClient. It primarily provides method signatures via docblocks for interacting with the Redshift Data API Service, including operations like executing statements, listing databases, and retrieving results.

classes.name: RedshiftDataAPIServiceClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the Amazon Redshift Data API Service, providing methods to execute and manage SQL statements and retrieve database information.

methods.name: batchExecuteStatement
methods.description: Executes one or more SQL statements in a batch.

methods.name: describeStatement
methods.description: Returns information about a specific SQL statement.

methods.name: executeStatementAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous execution of an SQL statement.

methods.name: getStatementResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of a statement.

methods.name: getStatementResultAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the result of a statement.

methods.name: getStatementResultV2
methods.description: Retrieves the result of a statement using a V2 API.

methods.name: getStatementResultV2Async
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the V2 result of a statement.
